points.point: Battle card 的競品比較本質是 sales positioning，不是可引用的技術規格
points.label: covered
points.why: states battle-card/sales sources are not formal specs and require formal evidence

points.point: 對競品的主張只有 R&S 內部 battle card 單一來源，對外使用前須補競品官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: covered
points.why: requires competitor official/third-party evidence; notes current claims come from R&S battle cards

points.point: battle card 數字不可當作 binding specifications，引用時只能標示為特定日期的 sales claim，並等待正式規格文件
points.label: partial
points.why: distinguishes binding specs from non-binding claims, but does not clearly mention battle-card numbers/as-of sales claims

points.point: AI 相關的 R&S 自動化工具（AI Script Assistant / CONTEST）在 battle card 中未提供文件版次，Keysight toolchain 需官方資料
points.label: partial
points.why: requires AI tool versions and Keysight official evidence, but omits CONTEST and battle-card version issue partly

points.point: CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant 的能力只有 PR 說法，缺 benchmark、correctness metric、coverage matrix 與驗證條件
points.label: covered
points.why: says CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant lacks benchmark, correctness metric, coverage matrix, validation method

points.point: non-signaling / production 平台的能力主張，必須分別引用各平台的正式 source page
points.label: partial
points.why: calls for formal non-signaling evidence, but not separate formal source pages for CMP180/CMP200/CMW100 K06

points.point: 競品官方 brochure 可用於描述競品，但不可用來驗證 R&S 自家的優勢主張
points.label: partial
points.why: uses competitor evidence for competitor description, but does not clearly say it cannot prove R&S advantages

points.point: AI-assisted 測試工作流的價值需用可量測指標衡量，而 PR 語言未提供量化 benchmark 或驗證方法
points.label: covered
points.why: requires quantified workflow metrics and validation methodology; notes no benchmark/method provided
